story: When old historic maps overlap with modern political maps
text: Is this actually different from when Matt Parker discovered ancient alien wisdom by plotting the lines between Woolworths stores? ( [VIDEO] ) Some of these maps are for time period not that distant from each other where the correlation is pretty straightforward, and those are probably telling at-least-partly-true narratives. For others, it's less clear. How many different modern and ancient maps are there which could conceivably have interesting (spurious) correlations?
